title: Untitled (Collage with CDs)
description: Mixed-media collage on white ground incorporates multiple compact discs, iridescent foil fragments, geometric fabric shapes in green, purple, and red, and a transparent plastic frame element. Ink line drawings of curved forms and musical notation-like marks scatter across the surface alongside perforated dots and metallic accents.
composition: scattered elements across white horizontal ground
keywords: compact disc musical notation mixed media
